claimText: PM Modi gave Rs 5000 AND green tea cures cancer AND WhatsApp is now free

brave.title: PIB Fact Check: Viral compound claims about government schemes are false
brave.description: Multiple compound viral messages combining claims about PM Modi schemes, health cures, and free apps are fabricated. PIB confirms no Rs 5000 transfer scheme exists.

brave.title: AltNews: Compound WhatsApp forwards combine multiple debunked claims
brave.description: Viral WhatsApp messages combining claims about government transfers, miracle cures, and free app offers are a common pattern used to spread misinformation.

brave.title: WhatsApp is NOT free — it has always been free to download
brave.description: WhatsApp has been free to download and use since 2016 when it dropped its $1/year subscription. Claims that WhatsApp is 'now free' are meaningless.

brave.title: Reuters Fact Check: Green tea cancer cure claim is fabricated
brave.description: WHO has never declared that green tea cures cancer. This claim has been repeatedly debunked by fact-checkers worldwide.

brave.title: BoomLive: No, PM Modi has not announced Rs 5000 direct transfer
brave.description: A viral WhatsApp message claiming PM Narendra Modi has announced Rs 5000 direct transfer to all Indian citizens is fake.
